verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single support-doc heading, "Import data into Trello" (trello-docs-26), with no detail on supported source tools, formats or fidelity. The REST API (trello-docs-21) could support a custom import, but that is a do-it-yourself workaround rather than a switching path. Missing for 10: named source tools supported (e.g. Asana, Jira, CSV), description of what data and structure is carried over, step-by-step import documentation, and hands-on or community corroboration that imports work.
